items.title: nVent Electric (NVT) Brings AI Data Center Cooling And Power Systems To SC26
items.summary: nVent Electric (NYSE:NVT) introduced new liquid cooling and engineered power distribution products for AI data centers at SC26. The company unveiled its CX121 coolant distribution unit, aimed at supporting higher density AI computing environments. nVent announced collaborations with AMD and NVIDIA, and outlined integration of Maverick Power following its recent acquisition. These liquid cooling, power distribution, and AMD and NVIDIA partnership updates at SC26 are worth weighing against the...

items.title: Cerebras Expands AI Inference Reach: Can It Challenge NVDA & AMD?
items.summary: CBRS is ramping up its AI inference capabilities with hyperscaler partnerships, wafer-scale innovations, and expanding capacity to challenge NVIDIA and Advanced Micro Devices.

items.title: NVIDIA Just Dropped 31% in a Month. Will NVDA Stock Hit $125 or $200 First?
items.summary: A CEO resignation, a credit rating on watch, and export rules scrambling China-bound GPUs have rattled the AI trade's biggest name. Two very different futures now compete for NVIDIA shares, and the next catalysts could tip the balance.

items.title: S&P’s NVIDIA Warning is Backward Looking Governance Theater That Gives Everyone an Opportunity to Buy at $150
items.summary: NVIDIA lost its CEO, drew a credit warning, and watched its stock slide nearly a third in a month. So why does one investor keep buying more every week, and which three numbers convinced him the real story lies elsewhere?

items.title: CoreWeave’s Default Odds Hit a Record. Core Scientific Has a Big Problem
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe cost of insuring CoreWeave’s debt against default hit a record, implying a 68% chance of default within five years. About 84% of Core Scientific’s revenue in the first nine months of 2026 came from CoreWeave.

items.title: NVIDIA's Data Center Sales Jump 110%: Can NVDA Keep the Pace Ahead?
items.summary: NVDA's Data Center revenues soar 110% to a record $107.6 billion, but can booming AI demand and new product ramp-ups sustain growth amid supply constraints?

items.title: Tepper Trims Alphabet by ~46% and Dumps Broadcom & AMD While Backing Micron and Oracle
items.summary: David Tepper sold off three AI winners that were still growing fast and bought two others instead. One of them pays its own way, while the other leans heavily on borrowed money and customer prepayments.

items.title: Does S&P's Credit Warning Matter For Nvidia Stock?
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings put Nvidia on CreditWatch with negative implications on Wednesday, Nov 25. That is a formal warning that it could cut Nvidia's credit rating. A credit rating is a grade on how safely a company can repay what it borrows. S&P cited rising management and governance risk, not money trouble.
